name: Joe Courtney
stance: Supports binding AI safeguards, including the AI Kill Switch Act against rogue AI agents, and urged the House to stay in session to pass them.

statements.text: Joined dozens of colleagues in a letter asking Speaker Johnson to cancel a scheduled recess so the House could enact AI safeguards, citing AI company CEOs' calls for Congress to slow the pace of AI development.

That’s unacceptable given the urgent warning from AI executives that Congress needs to act. There are bipartisan bills that will put long-overdue guardrails on AI, to protect program “breakouts,” and minors from AI deepfakes that we could vote on right now.
Cosponsored the bipartisan AI Kill Switch Act, a bill to establish third-party protections against rogue AI agents, citing a growing number of incidents involving rogue AI agents.
